# WB6 · Điều phối lịch · 7 ngày

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · state · Next.js: **built (U2)** (`/schedule`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-ui.js#schedule`
- Operations pages are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (dashboard, today) and `operations-ui.js` (schedule and the booking dialogs); calculations live in `PemaCRM` and `PemaOps` (`operations-data.js`).
- Same `schedule()` with `view = 'week'`: seven `week-day` columns starting at the chosen date, each with a title "CN, 20/09" and the day's bookings.
- Inventory note: Seven day columns, each with its count, cards and "＋ Đặt lịch". Every day of the demo week has bookings, so the empty-day text "Chưa có lịch" exists in code only.
- Page key `schedule` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"schedule\"]"} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"view\"][data-value=\"week\"]"}; it must show `.week-grid`.

## Next.js target
- Route: `/schedule` · status: **built (U2)** · U step: U2
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: `/schedule` "Điều phối lịch" (owner U2); test ids: `src/app/(admin)/schedule/page.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/schedule/appointment-sheet.test.tsx`, `src/lib/ops/schedule-view.test.ts`, `mock/schedule.test.ts::schedule board (mock)`, `mock/schedule.test.ts::reception transitions (mock)`, `mock/schedule.test.ts::booking rules (mock)`

## Prompt
```text
Build/port web screen WB6 "Điều phối lịch · 7 ngày" (group WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch, state) in pema-agent/frontend using only src/ui (tokens.json and the kit: Card, Tile, Badge, Button, Field, Dialog, Tabs, TableShell, EmptyState; Notice and FilterChip where the layout names them). Target: Next.js route /schedule (built (U2)).
```
